name: Solverix
description: Solverix is a mild partial agonist compound that occupies the same psychological and neurochemical space as a broad class of harder dependencies, providing just enough activation to prevent acute withdrawal while producing a plateau effect that prevents escalation. It is deliberately mildly addictive — designed as a lesser dependency to replace a greater one, with the assumption that Solverix dependency is manageable where the original was not. Nightshade sells it legally as a harm-reduction product; critics call it a dependency factory.
effects: Prevention of acute withdrawal across multiple substance classes
Mild euphoria (significantly less than primary substance)
Functional maintenance — users can work and socialize while on it
side_effects: Moderate addiction risk — roughly 60% of users develop Solverix dependency
Withdrawal from Solverix, while milder than primary substances, is real and unpleasant
Nightshade's pricing structure means ongoing dependency is profitable for them
street_price: Φ14 per dose; Φ80 per week supply
cultural_context: Solverix is controversial in every tier it reaches. Harm-reduction advocates defend it as meeting people where they are — a the Gray Zone user on Solverix can hold a job, stay housed, avoid crime. Critics, including Novafold and several medical associations, call it Nightshade's long con: a legal product designed to create a permanent customer base. On the Gray Zone, it's simply called 'the Softer' — the thing you take when you can't afford to be sick but can't quit.
story_hooks: A the Gray Zone community organizer is trying to get Solverix banned from local distribution — arguing it's economic predation — but the people it serves are desperate and the alternatives don't exist at this tier
Nightshade is quietly lobbying to have Solverix classified as a prescription drug — which would let them charge ten times the price while maintaining the 'medical legitimacy' framing
Someone the players know has been on Solverix for two years and is finally stable — but a supply disruption is coming, and real withdrawal is three days away
